description: Approximate forest, wooded patch and wooded park outlines manually traced from the level's satellite texture, split into at most 500 x 500 metre pieces.

coordinate_frame.ring_closure: First vertex is repeated as the last vertex.

viewer_conversion.Y: Sample published terrain at (east, north); heights are not stored here.

limitations: Approximate canopy boundaries, not surveyed land-use polygons or a complete tree inventory.
Boundary uncertainty is several satellite pixels (tens of metres). Confidence is a qualitative visual judgement, not a probability.
Wooded parks may contain lawns and paths; mixed or ambiguous patches are marked medium confidence.
Obvious open fields, major built areas and the northeastern motorway are excluded; narrow roads, clearings and individual buildings can remain inside a patch.
Regions touching the terrain edges are clipped; forest beyond the level is not represented.

subdivision.boundary_policy: Adjacent patches share edges without overlapping area. Retain small edge fragments.
